QuestInfo.name: [King of Crowns] Exchange Crown Fragment
QuestInfo.0:

#bEvent Details#k
You can randomly get Crown Fragments by completing the [King of Crowns] In Search of Shimmering Stars quest. Once you have enough, you can exchange 10 Crown Fragments to get a new Crown! Talk to Cassandra when you're ready to make a trade!
